title: B1 · L10 — Reported speech: statements
description: Estilo indirecto para afirmaciones: retroceso de tiempos verbales (backshift), diferencia entre 'said' y 'told' y cambios de pronombres y referencias temporales.

questions.prompt: Le cuentas a un amigo lo que tu compañera te dijo en el trabajo.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'I am tired.' Reported: 'She said she ___ tired.'
questions.explanation: En reported speech, el verbo retrocede un tiempo (backshift): presente simple → pasado simple. 'I am' → 'she was' con cambio de pronombre. Error típico del hispanohablante: mantener el presente ('she said she is tired') calcado del español 'dijo que está cansada'.
examples: 'I am happy.' → He said he was happy. → backshift presente→pasado
'She is a doctor.' → They said she was a doctor. → cambio de persona + tiempo

questions.prompt: Reportas hoy lo que alguien te dijo ayer sobre una llamada.
questions.question: Choose the correct reported form: 'I will call you tomorrow' (said yesterday).
options: He said he will call me tomorrow.
He said he would call me the next day.
He said he called me tomorrow.
He told he would call me tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 'Will' → 'would' en backshift. 'Tomorrow' cambia a 'the next/following day' cuando el reporte se hace después. Además cuidado: 'told' necesita objeto persona ('told me'), mientras 'said' no lo lleva directamente.
examples: 'I will help you.' → She said she would help me. → will→would
'We will arrive tomorrow.' → They said they would arrive the next day. → cambio temporal

questions.statement: 'Told' is followed directly by a person (told me, told him), but 'said' is not.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Regla clave: TOLD + persona (told me, told him, told us); SAID + [that] + oración (sin persona directa) o 'said TO + persona'. Error típico: 'She said me...' es agramatical. La forma correcta es 'She said (that)...' o 'She told me...'.
examples: She told me the news yesterday over coffee. → told + persona
She said (that) the news was really surprising. → said sin persona

questions.text: He said that he had been working there for years.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica: 'he'd been working' se dice muy rápido, con la 'd' apenas audible. 'That' se reduce a schwa /ðət/ casi imperceptible. Present perfect continuous ('have been working') → past perfect continuous ('had been working') en backshift.
examples: She said she'd been feeling ill for days. → estado prolongado reportado
They said they'd been living there for ages. → duración reportada

questions.prompt: Reportas a otro amigo lo que ella te contó sobre el cine.
questions.question: Choose: Direct: 'I saw the film last week.' Reported: 'She said she ___ the film ___.'
questions.explanation: Past simple → past perfect en backshift. 'Last week' cambia a 'the week before' o 'the previous week' cuando el reporte se hace más tarde. Error típico: mantener 'last week' como si fuera relativo al que escucha ahora.
examples: 'I ate sushi yesterday.' → She said she'd eaten sushi the day before. → past→past perfect
'I met him last month.' → He said he'd met her the month before. → cambio temporal

questions.prompt: Empareja cada tiempo directo con su equivalente en estilo indirecto:
questions.explanation: El BACKSHIFT es el retroceso obligatorio de los tiempos verbales al pasado más lejano cuando se reporta algo dicho antes. Regla mental: 'todo se corre un paso hacia atrás en el tiempo'. Otros: can→could, may→might, must→had to.
examples: 'I work here.' → He said he worked there. → present→past
'I will help.' → She said she would help. → will→would

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que tu amiga te dijo sobre una canción.
questions.question: Choose the natural reported speech: 'I love this song.'
options: She said she love this song.
She told she loved that song.
She said (that) she loved that song.
She said she is loving this song.
questions.explanation: Cambios necesarios: (1) backshift 'love' → 'loved'; (2) 'this' → 'that' por distancia temporal/espacial. 'That' antes de la cláusula es opcional. Errores: (A) falta backshift; (B) 'told' sin persona; (D) 'love' es verbo de estado, no admite continuous.
examples: She said she loved that book — kept talking about it. → backshift + this→that
He said he hated that music, actually. → mismo patrón con cambio de sentimiento

questions.target: She told me she was looking for a new job in another city, actually.
questions.explanation: Situación: le cuentas a un amigo lo que otra persona te contó sobre sus planes laborales. 'Told me' + backshift ('is looking' → 'was looking'). 'Actually' como discourse marker típico añade tono de revelación natural. Muy útil para chismes/noticias personales.
examples: He told me he was moving to Madrid, would you believe it? → noticia reportada
She said she was thinking about buying a house, which surprised me. → plan reportado + reacción

questions.statement: 'She said me that she was tired' is a correct reported speech sentence.
questions.explanation: FALSO. 'Said' NUNCA lleva objeto persona directo. Lo correcto: 'She said she was tired' (sin persona) o 'She told me she was tired' (con persona tras 'told'). Este error es TOP-1 en hispanohablantes por calco de 'me dijo que'.
examples: She told me she was tired — needed a break. → told + persona
She said (that) she was tired, poor thing. → said sin persona

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que un candidato mencionó sobre sus habilidades.
questions.question: Complete: Direct: 'I can drive.' Reported: 'He said he ___ drive.'
questions.explanation: El modal 'can' retrocede a 'could' en backshift. Otros modales sin equivalente pasado (must, should, might, ought to) NO cambian. Error típico: usar 'was able' (correcto en significado pero raro en reported speech) o mantener 'can'.
examples: 'I can help.' → She said she could help. → can→could
'I can speak French.' → He said he could speak French. → habilidad reportada

questions.text: She told me she would call me back later that evening.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción 'she'd call' en habla casual, aunque en dictado se prefiere 'she would' completo por claridad. 'Call me back' se enlaza fluido, casi 'call-mi-back'. Cambios: will→would; 'this evening' → 'that evening' por distancia temporal desde el reporte.
examples: He told me he'd visit us the next day for lunch. → will→would + tomorrow→next day
They said they'd send the report the following week. → cambio temporal

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que alguien te dijo sobre lo que estaba haciendo.
questions.question: Which reported speech is correct for 'I am studying English right now'?
options: He said he is studying English right now.
He said he was studying English at that moment.
He told he was studying English then.
He said he studied English now.
questions.explanation: Present continuous ('am studying') → past continuous ('was studying'). 'Right now' → 'at that moment' o 'then'. Errores: (A) sin backshift; (C) 'told' sin persona; (D) 'now' contradice el reporte diferido.
examples: She said she was working at that moment — couldn't chat. → estudiando + tiempo
He said he was reading at that time, so I didn't disturb him. → actividad reportada

questions.statement: If we report something that is still true, we can keep the original tense without backshifting.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Si la información SIGUE VIGENTE al momento de reportar, el backshift es OPCIONAL. 'She said she LIVES in Paris' (si aún vive allí) es perfectamente válido. Con verdades universales, casi nunca se hace backshift: 'The teacher said the Earth IS round.'
examples: She said she works at Google. → sigue trabajando ahí, sin backshift
He said the Earth is round. → verdad universal, no cambia

questions.prompt: Reportas lo que un colega te dijo sobre su avance en un informe.
questions.question: Choose: Direct: 'I have finished the report.' Reported: 'He said he ___ the report.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect ('have finished') → past perfect ('had finished') en backshift. Errores: (A) past simple pierde el matiz de acción reciente; (C) 'has' sin retroceso; (D) past continuous cambia el significado (proceso vs acción completada).
examples: 'I have seen it.' → She said she had seen it before. → pres perfect → past perfect
'I have never been there.' → He said he had never been there. → experiencia reportada

questions.target: He said he'd already booked the hotel for our trip, thankfully — one less thing to worry about.
questions.explanation: Situación: le cuentas a otro amigo lo que os planificó un tercero. Combina 'said' + past perfect ('had already booked'). Contracción 'he'd' obligatoria en habla. 'Thankfully' + comentario final ('one less thing...') añade la reacción emocional típica del habla real.
examples: She said she'd already sent the email, which was a relief. → alivio reportado
They said they'd already finished the project, honestly, I couldn't believe it. → sorpresa positiva
